Subject: Laptop battery drains quickly
Description: The laptop battery loses most of its charge within two hours of normal office use.

Subject: Workstation fails to wake
Description: The desktop workstation remains unresponsive after entering sleep mode and requires a forced restart.

Subject: Monitor flickering intermittently
Description: The monitor flickers when connected through DisplayPort and becomes unstable at the recommended resolution.
Resolution_Notes: Replaced the defective DisplayPort cable and updated the graphics driver. The monitor now operates normally.

Subject: Network switch port failure
Description: Several switch ports stopped passing network traffic and remained inactive after cable replacement.
Resolution_Notes: Applied the latest firmware and replaced the failed port module. Connectivity tests completed successfully.

Subject: Wireless signal disconnects
Description: The wireless access point disconnects nearby devices repeatedly during conference calls.

Subject: Printer produces faded pages
Description: Printed documents appear faded on the right side even after toner cartridges were reseated.
Resolution_Notes: Cleaned the imaging assembly and recalibrated print density. Test pages now show consistent output.

Subject: Smartphone microphone issue
Description: Call recipients report low and distorted audio when the smartphone microphone is used.

Subject: Tablet charging port loose
Description: The charging cable does not remain securely connected and charging stops when the tablet is moved.
Resolution_Notes: Replaced the damaged charging connector and verified stable charging with the approved power adapter.

Subject: Conference camera loses focus
Description: The conference camera repeatedly loses focus when participants move within the meeting room.

Subject: Projector image has blue tint
Description: The projected image shows a persistent blue tint across all input sources and presentation modes.
Resolution_Notes: Reset the color profile and recalibrated the projector. Image colors are now displayed accurately.

Subject: Chair height adjustment stuck
Description: The chair height lever does not engage and the seat remains fixed at its lowest position.
Resolution_Notes: Replaced the faulty pneumatic cylinder and confirmed smooth height adjustment under load.

Subject: Standing desk motor noisy
Description: The desk motor makes a grinding noise while raising the work surface and occasionally stops midway.

Subject: Generator will not start
Description: The portable generator does not start during the scheduled operational test despite a fully charged battery.

Subject: Helmet suspension strap damaged
Description: One suspension strap is torn and no longer secures the safety helmet correctly.
Resolution_Notes: Replaced the damaged suspension assembly and inspected the helmet shell for additional defects.

Subject: First aid kit seal broken
Description: The first aid kit seal was broken and several sterile dressings were missing during inspection.
Resolution_Notes: Restocked all missing supplies and applied a new inspection seal with an updated contents checklist.

Subject: Multimeter readings fluctuate
Description: Voltage measurements fluctuate significantly when testing a stable reference source.

Subject: Thermal camera display freezes
Description: The thermal camera display freezes after several minutes and requires a battery removal to restart.
Resolution_Notes: Updated the device firmware and reset the thermal calibration profile. Extended testing showed no further freezes.

Subject: Scanner misses barcode labels
Description: The barcode scanner intermittently fails to read standard asset labels at normal scanning distance.

Subject: Label printer jams repeatedly
Description: Label media jams near the output roller after printing several consecutive asset tags.
Resolution_Notes: Cleaned the feed path and replaced the worn platen roller. A batch of fifty labels printed without errors.

Subject: Server reports memory errors
Description: Hardware diagnostics report recurring memory correction errors during intensive workloads.

Subject: Storage array alarm active
Description: The storage array displays a warning alarm and reports degraded performance on one drive group.

Subject: UPS switches to battery unexpectedly
Description: The UPS transfers to battery power even though the utility supply remains stable and within range.
Resolution_Notes: Recalibrated the input sensitivity settings and replaced a faulty voltage sensing module. Transfer tests passed.

Subject: Camera overheats during recording
Description: The digital camera becomes unusually hot and shuts down during extended high-resolution video recording.

Subject: PA system audio distortion
Description: The portable PA system produces distorted audio at moderate volume from both microphone and line inputs.
Resolution_Notes: Replaced the damaged input board and tested microphone and line sources across the full operating range.

Subject: Pallet jack steering resistance
Description: The electric pallet jack requires excessive force to steer and makes a scraping sound during left turns.
